message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep for the Products.txt list, covering the 24-hour window ending 2026-07-04 05:10 IST. One confirmed new relevant product finding was retained: Microsoft Edge. Other candidates reviewed during the sweep were excluded because they were outside the 24-hour window, did not clearly match the monitored product list, or were only weak third-party mentions.

**Finding 1**

- Product: Microsoft Edge, including Chromium-based Stable Channel and mobile Edge entries where applicable
- Issue: Microsoft Edge security update with newly published Edge CVE entries on July 3, 2026. Public CVE feeds list multiple Edge CVEs in this batch, including CVE-2026-57975, CVE-2026-57981, CVE-2026-57984, CVE-2026-57985, CVE-2026-57986, CVE-2026-57988, CVE-2026-57991, CVE-2026-57992, CVE-2026-57993, CVE-2026-58276, CVE-2026-58278, CVE-2026-58282 through CVE-2026-58295, CVE-2026-58298, CVE-2026-58299, and CVE-2026-58300.
- Severity: Mixed. At least one GitHub/NVD-mirrored advisory in the batch, CVE-2026-58284, is listed as High severity. Microsoft’s Edge release notes confirmed the July 2 security update but said CVEs would be added as available, so individual Microsoft severity mapping was not fully visible in the release-note page at review time.
- Description: Microsoft released Edge Stable version 150.0.4078.48 with the latest Chromium security updates. CVE feed entries published on July 3 describe several Edge vulnerability classes, including type confusion, use-after-free, improper authorization, improper input validation, SSRF/spoofing, path traversal/link-following, information disclosure, and Android-specific Edge issues.
- Why it appears relevant: Microsoft Edge is explicitly listed in Products.txt. Microsoft’s own release notes confirm a fresh Edge security update, and the July 3 CVE entries name Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) or Microsoft Edge for Android directly.
- Source: Microsoft Edge Stable release notes (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnote-stable-channel), Microsoft Edge security release notes (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnotes-security), GitHub Advisory for CVE-2026-58284 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-28f5-cgmh-4pfj), CVE.report recent CVE listing (https://cve.report/), and Microsoft Security Update Guide (https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/).

**Possible Matches Needing Review**

None retained for this run. MongoDB-adjacent, Defender, SharePoint, Apache Tomcat, OpenSSL, and WordPress/plugin items surfaced during searching, but the credible date or product mapping did not support inclusion as a fresh confirmed match for the monitored list in this 24-hour window.

Closing note: Immediate review is recommended for managed Edge deployments because several July 3 Edge CVE entries are high-impact browser classes and at least one mirrored advisory is High severity. Confirm that Edge Stable is updated to 150.0.4078.48 or later where Edge is deployed; no other monitored product had a confirmed fresh finding in this run.
